purpose: Persistent source registry and completeness contract for the Trentino event database.
coverageWindow: Rolling 12-month overlap window. Include any event with endDate >= run date and startDate <= run date + 12 months, plus recurring series with at least one occurrence in that interval. Events do not need to start after the run date.

pipeline.phase1: GitHub Actions deterministic enumeration of known calendars into data/discovered_candidates.json plus data/source_audit.json.
pipeline.phase2: Daily AI pass resolves every candidate, closes PARTIAL source gaps, reads PDFs/flyers, deduplicates, enriches DE/EN/IT and updates data/events.json.
pipeline.phase3: AI web/social discovery finds events and durable sources outside known calendars; durable sources are added back to this registry.

rules: Use search engines only for source discovery and gap closing; never treat search-result snippets as a complete scan of a known event calendar.
Include ongoing events and recurring series with future occurrences; never require startDate >= run date.
For every P0/P1 calendar, enumerate all pages, offsets, load-more results, date buckets, category tabs and child links needed for the overlap window.
When a municipality landing page delegates to a separate official agenda, crawl the underlying agenda rather than the thin landing page.
Record a source-reported total when available and reconcile it against records seen before marking the source COMPLETE.
Follow linked PDFs, brochures, downloadable calendars, flyers and attachments and extract every separately named dated event or recurring series.
Expand 'other available dates', recurring weekday patterns, weekly markets and series pages.
Open detail pages for dates, venue, municipality, organizer, price, image, recurrence and cancellation/status verification.
Never silently skip long-running exhibitions, guided visits, family programmes, small local events or non-Top-Events.
A timeout, blocked attachment, changed pagination or unresolved count mismatch must be logged PARTIAL or FAILED.
Deduplicate only after discovery, using name + date/recurrence + municipality/venue + organizer/source URL.
Add newly discovered recurring websites, organizer calendars and public social accounts to this registry so coverage expands over time.

rules: Search public posts/pages for each territorial and organizer source family, not only accounts already known by name.
Search both Italian and German/English variants where relevant.
If a public flyer/social post gives a credible date and location but no official calendar record exists, add the event with confidence/confirmation metadata and continue looking for corroboration.
Never use private/inaccessible social content or guess unreadable flyer details.
Do not infer cancellation from a social post becoming unavailable.
When a durable public social account repeatedly publishes event announcements, persist its exact public account URL in this registry on a later revision.

completionGate.userFacingRule: If any P0 source is PARTIAL or FAILED, surface a coverage warning even when there are no event changes.
